newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary budget deficit drops to 114.8 bln forints.
newsitem.headline: Hungary budget deficit drops to 114.8 bln forints.

text.p: Hungary reduced its accumulated 1996 central state budget deficit by 6.2 billion forints in September to 114.8 billion forints from 121.0 billion in August, the finance ministry said in a statement on Monday.
The figures do not include privatisation and one-off revenues.
Hungary's 1996 central budget deficit ceiling is 232.9 billion forints, not including privatisation and one-off revenues.
